activation_requires.authority: re-issue hermes-agent.source.json through scripts/hermes_prepare.py and scripts/friday_install.py
activation_requires.decision_needed: authorise running the existing install/compose path to re-issue the receipt with the patched file, or keep the fix prepared only
activation_requires.why_not_done_here: that receipt is the composition authority for the running product; re-issuing it is the same class of gate the owner already reserved for the compressor repair, so it is not something to hand-edit

change.effect: an unknown format value returns unsupported_format with the allowed list before scoped_file is consulted; every allow/deny decision stays where it was

incident.detection: the unit failed and systemd retried; the journal named the exact check
incident.downtime: about two minutes, no message lost and no store change
incident.lesson: editing a pinned source file cannot activate a change; the source receipt must be re-issued by the install path
incident.recovery: the original file was restored from the pre-change copy and the unit restarted; the gateway is active again with pid 872987, state running, telegram connected, active_agents 0
incident.what_happened: the patched file was installed and the unit restarted; the gateway refused to start with ValueError: friday_dashboard_owner_unproved
incident.why: hermes_cli/friday_dashboard_owner._verify_source_files compares every source file against the pinned hermes-agent.source.json receipt (schema friday.hermes-source.v1, status SOURCE_COMPOSED_NOT_RUNTIME_ACCEPTED, more than a thousand file rows with sha256, bytes and mode); editing file_tools.py changed one row

preconditions_verified.note: 26 historical runs remain in OBSERVING from earlier eras; they are pinned history rows and do not block new work

risk: the gateway is the product under test; a restart interrupts the user's chat for its duration but does not clear history or the store

rollback.how: restore the saved original file_tools.py and restart the same unit

side_effect_to_handle.consequence: the tester's independent admission pins the old identity and now refuses with «Fresh quiescent gateway required for independent ordinary input»
side_effect_to_handle.fix: routine: rebuild the next wave's authority with the current pid and start_time, exactly as every earlier wave did
side_effect_to_handle.what: the gateway restart changed pid 672036/start_time 8162221 to pid 872987/start_time 10566907

verification_after_restart: gateway pid changes and the unit reports running
telegram reaches connected and active_agents is 0
a live write_file call with format 'utf-8_no_bom' returns unsupported_format with the allowed list
a live write_file call with format 'text' still writes
an out-of-scope path still returns product_user_scope_refused
the D-12 three-part task is repeated as one linked sequence
why: the D-12 root cause is an opaque refusal: an unsupported write_file format reaches the scope gate and comes back as «Это действие недоступно», so the model cannot correct itself and loops until the framework hard-stops it
